test_gil_deadlock_single_thread: test for GIL deadlock when running Python to C++ callback in a single thread
test_gil_deadlock_parallel_threads: test for GIL deadlock when running Python to C++ callbacks across 8 parallel threads
test_gil_deadlock_sequential_threads: test for GIL deadlock when running Python to C++ callbacks across 8 sequential threads
test_gil_deadlock_from_process: test for GIL deadlock when running Python to C++ callback in a separate process
test_cross_module_gil_acquire: test that the GIL can be acquired by another module from a GIL-released state
